resources.string: Smart tools for land, people and objects
Measure land area and perimeter by marking positions or walking its border.
Measure a route or the straight-line distance between locations.
Measure a person\'s height or an object\'s size using a known reference.
Measure small objects using a calibrated on-screen ruler.
Check a surface using your phone\'s motion sensors.
GPS is approximate and is not a substitute for a professional land survey. Best outdoors with clear sky.
Location permission is required for GPS measurement.
You need at least three GPS points for area.
Weak GPS accuracy; move outdoors or wait.
Take a photo with the person/object and a known-size reference at the SAME distance from the camera. Then tap reference start/end, target start/end.
Tap the START of the reference
Tap the END of the reference
Tap the START of the person or object
Tap the END of the person or object
Perspective changes the scale. This estimate is reliable only if reference and target are at the same camera distance and both fully visible.
Screen DPI varies by device. Compare a standard 85.60 mm bank card and adjust the scale until it matches.
Keep the phone flat; sensor measurements may need calibration.
Test ads are enabled until the new app\'s own AdMob IDs are configured.
Ads: banner on home and results; interstitial after 3 saved measurements, no more than once every 3 minutes. No ads during measurement.
Privacy options are not currently required or available.
Location points, photos, and saved results remain on your device. This app does not upload them to our servers. AdMob may process data under Google\'s privacy terms with applicable consent.
Move several meters before adding a new point.
Use Add GPS point at each corner, or Start walking along the boundary. The dotted drawing is a sketch, not a satellite map.
